tweet.text:
Yeah, we’re just millions of moral degenerates

That’s all we are

Not a decent human among us

Or a fiber of moral decency

Look, I get that you disagree with us now 

But this is pretty condescending 

And very unfair

You paint with a very broad brush

With your eyes closed

quote.text:
"There is not a flicker of the old Republican Party left. No embers of fiscal conservatism, global leadership, or moral decency. Reaganism’s ashes are stone-cold. Milwaukee showed us a MAGA movement [of] vindictiveness, paranoia, and hero-worship."
https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/magazine-columnists/3089122/elegy-for-the-grand-old-party/
